Data:Ch.orderform.send.json.label: An Advertisement from Cater & Hero
Data:Ch.orderform.send.json.startdescription: The firm Cater & Hero, alive to the possibility of commerce, has sent a smudgily printed catalogue addressed to 'The Libarianm'.

Data:Chaima.json.label: Lalla Chaima
Data:Chaima.json.desc: Huntress, goumier, occasional Bureau consultant. When it can't be killed, and it really needs killing, Chaima's the one they turn to.

xexts.befriend．chaima．zachary: Chaima and Zachary have something almost like a friendship.

Data:Chaima.likes.agdistis.json.desc: Chaima has grown to like Agdistis.

Data:Chaima.likes.zachary.json.desc: Chaima has developed an odd attachment to Zachary.

Data:Chair.bells.json.Label: Bell-Tower Chair
Data:Chair.bells.json.Desc: Sturdy, undistinguished, and, like so much else in the House, the last of its kind.

xexts.scrutiny: Serena Blackwood brought this chair up the church tower stairs to sit and read by candle-light. The stairs were tough on her knees, but she learnt that Governor Collers was unlikely to bother her here.

Data:Chair.church.atrium.json.Label: Atrium Chair
Data:Chair.church.atrium.json.Desc: Reserved for latecomers, non-believers, and the pensive.

xexts.scrutiny: Is there any accusatory element to its creaks? Was that intentional?

Data:Chair.church.heart.json.Label: Restful Seat
Data:Chair.church.heart.json.Desc: A dawn-coloured seat for a solar congregation.

xexts.scrutiny: Sit in serenity.

Data:Chair.church.knock.json.Label: Uncomfortable Seat
Data:Chair.church.knock.json.Desc: Shaped to assure the attention of the faithful.

xexts.scrutiny: Ornamented with the circled sun-cross of the Church.

Data:Chair.church.lantern.json.Label: Contemplative Seat
Data:Chair.church.lantern.json.Desc: Perch here to meditate on the mysteries of dawn.

xexts.scrutiny: 'Light like the ever-burning Wheel rolls all our sins away / they fly forgotten as a dream dies at the opening day.'
Shadows shift, sun-bars follow.

Data:Chair.garden2.json.Label: Restful Garden Chair
Data:Chair.garden2.json.Desc: Sit here and listen to the trees grow. Or the leaves fall. Preferences differ.

xexts.scrutiny: Inlaid with green-stained bone.

Data:Chair.grail.a.json.Label: Greene's Red Chair
Data:Chair.grail.a.json.Desc: A little wobbly. Greene used to lean forward.

xexts.scrutiny: Someone has absent-mindedly carved symbols down one leg. From top to bottom: a cup; a winged insect; an axe; a candle.

Data:Chair.grail.b.json.Label: Wine-Dark Chair
Data:Chair.grail.b.json.Desc: An elegant eighteenth-century piece imported from France.

xexts.scrutiny: There were twelve of these, but Gervinus van Lauren had most of them broken up and burnt the week after his arrival. 'Bad memories,' was all he would say.

Data:Chair.grail.c.json.Label: Expansive Chair
Data:Chair.grail.c.json.Desc: Upholstered in a velvet of peculiar richness that invites the hand. Sit down a while. You've earned it.

xexts.scrutiny: A printed card reads: NOW SAFE TO SLEEP IN THIS CHAIR. G.C.

Data:Chair.gullscry.json.Label: Snug Chair
Data:Chair.gullscry.json.Desc: A wicker chair with a soft white lap blanket for chilly evenings.

xexts.scrutiny: Is the blanket bear-skin? Polar bear? It might be, but it's softer than one would expect.

Data:Chair.knock.json.Label: Chair of Challenges
Data:Chair.knock.json.Desc: Here the Librarian Harries sat, to formulate the paradoxes he would bequeath to van Lauren.

xexts.scrutiny: Perhaps the faintest, driest voice murmured: 'Who will see the Second Dawn?' Or perhaps that was only something that once I read.
A little scratchy, but an optimistic sort would point out that makes it easier to stay awake when one's eyelids waver.
A sometime seat of the Secretary Enigmatic of the Curia, whose responsibilities and even identity were not widely discussed, but might conceivably have been one called 'cc'.
The pattern was reputedly preferred by Baron Thomas.
On a clear late evening in July, look west from the Gullscry Tower and the sky will be this colour exactly.
This chair is innocent of chairly secrets.

Data:Chair.severe2.json.Label: Spartan Chair
Data:Chair.severe2.json.Desc: The cushion has been removed, perhaps as an act of petty revenge.

xexts.scrutiny: Hard Librarians value hard chairs.

Data:Chair.sky.json.Label: Melodic Chair
Data:Chair.sky.json.Desc: Someone appears to have tuned the squeaks.

xexts.scrutiny: Relax on it just so, and you can almost make out the first notes of Kitty Mazarine's fuging-tune, 'Thirty Birds'.

Data:Chair.sky.x.json.Label: Lumpy Melodic Chair
Data:Chair.sky.x.json.Desc: Someone appears to have tuned the squeaks.

xexts.scrutiny: Someone appears to have tuned the squeaks.
A creaking cane back generates the occasional spiteful splinter.

Data:Chalice.lambig.json.Label: Lambig Broceliande (Chalice)
Data:Chalice.lambig.json.Desc: Distilled from apples in the oldest forest of the western Continent.

xexts.scrutiny: 'Lambig and alembic,' Thirza Blake once observed, 'arise from the same root. As do alchemy, and khemia, which is the land of the black earth. When you plant an apple-seed, speak these sounds to the soil.'

Data:Chandlery.aglaophotis.json.label: Make an Aglaophotis-Scented Candle
Data:Chandlery.aglaophotis.json.desc: The air clears, and my thoughts likewise.

Data:Chandlery.fragrant.chalice.json.label: Make a Chalice-Candle
Data:Chandlery.fragrant.chalice.json.desc: The scent is rich as roses.

Data:Chandlery.historywax.json.label: Make a Historywax Candle
Data:Chandlery.historywax.json.desc: The flame will flicker, and the Histories ripple.

Data:Chandlery.honeyscar.json.label: Make a Honeyscar-Scented Candle
Data:Chandlery.honeyscar.json.desc: A roaring orange flame, a coppery sweetness.

Data:Chandlery.pyrus.json.label: Make a pyrus auricalcinus Candle
Data:Chandlery.pyrus.json.startdescription: A potent light, in the right place.
Data:Chandlery.pyrus.json.desc: Forge and Nectar: so many consider them opposites. Is there another truth in the Malachite's shadows?

Data:Chart.genealogical.json.Label: Genealogical Chart
Data:Chart.genealogical.json.Desc: Six years ago, King George's heir Edward killed him in a quarrel over Edward's womanising. The kingdom was saved from constitutional collapse by  Henry Huddleston Abney-Hastings, 13th Count of Loudoun - who claimed descent through the Plantagenet line. Heaven lift the New King!

xexts.scrutiny: Collers was keenly interested in the history of the houses Tudor, Plantagenet, Hanover, Windsor, et cetera, all the way back to the days of the Leashed Flame. He has also doodled the Suppression Bureau seal by the name of King Henry's mother Edith. Of course: Lady Edith serves as Nocturnal Secretary... the minister with final responsibility for the entire Bureau.

Data:Chat.mr.k.block.json.label: Mr Kille is absent
Data:Chat.mr.k.block.json.startdescription: Mr Kille is absent... on the Librarian's business. But I already knew that, didn't I?

Data:Chat.mr.k.friend.json.label: Speak with Mr Kille
Data:Chat.mr.k.friend.json.startdescription: Mr Kille always enjoys a chance to catch up with me. [If you don't choose a topic, Mr Kille will offer help, as a friend.]

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: Ask Mr Kille about something specific; or leave this empty to wait for him to finish with his hammer and lend his assistance.

Data:Chat.mr.k.json.label: Speak with Mr Kille
Data:Chat.mr.k.json.startdescription: Mr Kille likes conversations about endings. (His wife prefers to talk about beginnings.)  A shilling will buy his help for a day.

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: Ask Mr Kille about something specific; or offer him payment for his help.
